title: 精神疾患とその治療
subtitle: Psychiatric Disorders and Treatments
keywords: mind, spirit, soul or will 2.brain function 3.psychological treatment
educationalGoal: What are mental activities? We take a look on how they are manifested, how they are caught in our perception. Students are supposed to have fundamental knowledge on brain function, which is the commanding center of mental activities in the body of human being. We are going to look into the meaning and significance of psychiatric treatment. The main psychiatric disorders including their treatment are briefly explained with the things described above. Students are supposed to understand the outline of psychiatry as a basic knowledge of clinical psychologist.
advice: In various clinical settings, one to one consultation, group interviewing with a patients and his or her family, friends an so on, at a medical institution, at a facility, and at home, we are going to think what can be found, what can happen, and what can be done. We are going to examine the case where a client can`t adapt oneself to one`s circumstances, how can we help him or her? What are problems on the course of life time in our modern society? What are they from their birth to the infancy before going to school? During compulsory education? After the education thereafter or during the vocational training? During the work life? Or unfortunately out of work as a NEET? On marriage life? In the middle age when we have responsibility of the family and work? What are problems when children become grown-up, in his or her elder or older age? We are going to think about the cases when we may suffer severe disease in-between, may encounter severe accidents and have handicaps. Or when we may have cancer and unfortunately we may live a few more months, how can we live in the community, and surmount our problems of life. Or if we can`t solve our problems and turn to be pathological, what can our community do? Students are supposed to think themselves about the issues above. There are many possibilities and points of view. The performances by each clinician can be delivered case by case with flexibility along each situation. As still a college student, it is advisable for you to be able to have various ideas on possibilities and points of view to deal with the problems.
books: ①The new version of holding a desperate life with ease 〜a world named researches by patients themselves by Ikuyoshi Mukaiyachi and the Beteru Home in Urakawa Ichimugi publisher ②Healing of mental calamities by Katsumasa An Sakuhinsha publisher ③Mind and Brain by Yuichirou Anzai Iwanami shinsho ④What every body is saying. An Ex-FBI Agent`s Guide to Speed-Reading People by Joe Navaro, Marvin Karlins Kawaide bunko
requiredKnowledge: To have own words to describe inside or outside of himself or herself. to be able to discuss with other persons what happens inside oneself, and what is felt or notices on observing others.

achievementLevels.ideal: To have better understanding of oneself and others around oneself of today`s society. To keep in mind manifestation and maintenance of better personal functioning. To make use of available social resources according to each one`s needs.
achievementLevels.standard: To percept and recognize how oneself is and how others around oneself are in today`s society. To be able to notice the appearing possibility of psychiatric disorders in this today`s chaotic world.

lessons.content: General remarks. After listening to students` impression on psychiatric treatment in Japan today, the first class is about psychiatric interview, one to one interview and group interview. In the second class, what can be assessed in the interview. It is discussed in small groups if possible. In the third class, we will discuss what happens in groups of human society.
lessons.operation: Discussion, questions and answers. In the first class the U-tube on open- dialogue is presented. In the third class we will have group discussion, then a quiz about class 1,2 and 3 in 20 minutes.
lessons.assignments: For the first class, read from the beginning to the first line of page 4 of the text③ as preparation. For the second class, read the text③ from the 2nd line of page 4 to the 7th line of page 45 as preparation and looking back about class 1 and 2 as review.

lessons.content: Detailed explanations. Class 4 is about child psychiatry. What do we have problems and themes since birth in a childhood? Class 5 is about major psychiatric disorders and problems since compulsory education to middle age. Class 6 is about psychiatry on major shocks and happenings in life.
lessons.operation: Brief introduction and discussion. In class 5 two U-tubes on anxiety disorders are shown. In class 6 one U-tube in the case of great earthquake is presented.
lessons.assignments: For class 4, read the text④ prom the beginning to the 11th line of page 84 as preparation. For class 5, read the text① from the beginning to page 45 as preparation. For class 6, read the text② from the beginning to page 95 as review .
lessons.minutes: For class4 2hrs. For class5 1hr. For class6 2hrs.

lessons.content: Class 7 is about the function of mental hospital. The meaning and limitation of pharmacological therapy is presented. In class 8, brief explanation of schizophrenia and mood disorders, and their rehabilitations are presented. In class 9 old and new addictions are explained.
lessons.operation: Discussion and presentations of U-tubes in each class. In class 8 students are supposed to make a report on the role of clinical psychologist in the rehabilitation.
lessons.assignments: For class 7 read the text③ from page 218 to 255 as review. For class 8 read the text① from page 46 to 74 and from page 80 to 91 as review. For class 9 read the text① from page 177 to 186 as preparation and read the text ① from page 188 to 227 as review.
lessons.minutes: For class7 1.5hrs . For class8 1hr. For class9 20mins and 40 mins.

lessons.content: Class 10 is about senile psychiatric disorders. In class 11 recent development is described in the community psychiatry in Japan and Italy. In class 12 psychotherapy practice and its recent world trend are explained.
lessons.operation: Discussion and presentations of U-tubes in each class.
lessons.assignments: For class 10 read the text③ from page 133 to the mid of 151, and from page 250 to 255 as preparation. For class 11 read the text① from page 119 to 140 as preparation and read the same book from page 150 to 163 as review. For class 12 read the text③ from page 218 to 249 as preparation.
lessons.minutes: For class 10 1hr. For class 11 40mins and 20mins . For class 12 1hr.

lessons.content: Class 13 is about support and care provided for families and in community. Written examination is carried out in class 14. Looking back and review on the course are done in class 15.
lessons.operation: In class 13 explanation and questions and answers after U-tube presentations . In class 14 final exam. In class 15 telling impression on the course and discussions.
lessons.assignments: For class 13 read the text② from page 99 to 201 as preparation. For class 14 prepare the noticed topics.
